## Gesture debounce & preview caching

- **One gesture → one action**: Re-clicking the active Editor/Split/Preview title-bar mode is a no-op (no focus churn or notify). Preview click-to-source and go-to-definition ignore a bounced second jump at the same spot within a short window; queued Typst click/caret/definition requests keep only the newest of each kind.
- **Typst live cache**: Unchanged source reuses existing page sheets (no recompile/redraw). `PdfView::reload` skips when sheet `Arc`s and page sizes are unchanged.
- **PDF page conversion**: Adjacent pages convert in one background job with a shared Hayro `RenderCache` instead of re-parsing the PDF per page.
